title: Add logo to dashboard and apply gradient styling

requirements.summary: Display the LivSpan logo in the top left corner of the dashboard page, matching the styling and placement used on the login page
acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in top left corner of StartDashboard page
Logo uses the same IMG_8398-1.png asset as the login page
Logo styling matches the login page implementation

file_operations.description: Add the LivSpan logo (IMG_8398-1.png) to the top left corner of the dashboard page. Position it absolutely or within a header container matching the login page styling. Ensure the logo is properly sized and aligned consistent with its usage elsewhere in the application.

requirements.summary: Apply a bright green gradient effect to all page headings across the application
acceptanceCriteria: All page headings use a luminous green gradient
Gradient is consistent across all pages
Text remains readable against the background

file_operations.description: Add a utility class for bright green gradient text effect using CSS background-clip and text-fill-color properties. Define the gradient with luminous green color stops that maintain readability and align with the existing DNA helix theme.

Apply the bright green gradient utility class to the main page heading ('Your LivSpan Factors' or equivalent). Ensure the gradient is visible and the text remains readable against the dark background.

requirements.summary: Style the fasting timer number line display with a green-to-blue gradient effect
acceptanceCriteria: The fasting timer number display uses a green-to-blue gradient
Gradient transitions smoothly from green to blue

file_operations.description: Apply a green-to-blue gradient effect to the fasting timer number display. Use CSS background-clip technique or inline gradient styles to create a smooth transition from green to blue across the timer digits. Ensure the gradient complements the existing helix theme colors and maintains number legibility.
